name: gatana
description: Find and follow your organization's Gatana skills, and use the tools of its Gatana gateway.

interface.longDescription: Gatana stores how work is done in your organization as skills: how to deploy a service, review a pull request or investigate an error. This plugin makes the agent check those skills at the start of a task and follow the one that applies. You see only the skills you have access to in Gatana.
defaultPrompt: Which Gatana skills apply to this task?
Save how we did this as a Gatana skill
